description:
Basic Information

  • Full Title: Edmond & Lily Safra PhD Studentship in Parkinson's Disease
  • Host Institution: Imperial College London
  • Department: Brain Sciences / UK DRI at Imperial
  • Supervisors: Dr Cynthia Sandor, Dr Katarzyna Zoltowska
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 3 years (+ up to 6 months writing-up)
  • Start Date: 2026/27
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Stipend: £23,805 per year (tax-free)
  • Tuition Fees: Home fees covered
  • Eligibility: Home fee status
  • Application Deadline: 15 October 2026

How to Apply

Email CV, brief statement of research interests & motivation, and contact details for two academic referees to Dr Cynthia Sandor (c.sandor@imperial.ac.uk) or Dr Katarzyna Zoltowska (zoltowska@imperial.ac.uk).
